scope: Native HTML media with controlled gesture-prime observation ordering; no official or Safari fidelity claim
reproduced: After the existing 2200ms prime timeout, resume starts with the old temporary mute still enabled.
A late fulfilled gesture-prime callback pauses actual replacement HTML music and seeks it back to the old position (0.828424 -> 0.517615); its native clock then stops.
Pause/stop/start and a replacement prime have no ownership guard against late mute/seek/pause callbacks. Nine of eleven new controlled tests fail on the parent source.
changes: Keep the primed media, original mute state and position in an owned object; late fulfilled/rejected callbacks can finish only their own object.
End the pending prime synchronously before current startMusic/pauseMusic/stopMusic or another prime reuses media.
End only the matching prime after session-preparation completion or timeout; an old timeout does not cancel a replacement prime.
Preserve normal gesture-bound context/media activation, countdown, hit-mixer preparation, existing import/data/asset behavior and judgment parameters.

commands.command: node --check js/app.js; node --check tests/audio-gesture-prime-browser.cjs; git diff --check

browserMethod: Force the existing HTML fallback through a controlled Web Audio prepare failure. Actual Leave All Behind EZ music, native play/pause/seek/clock, original resume/countdown, real 2200ms timeout and mixer still run. Delay only the observation of the first muted play promise after native playback begins. Fulfilled-after-timeout, rejected-after-timeout and cancelled-resume/replacement-prime scenarios pass. No simulation of output latency or organic Safari network timing is claimed.
browserOutcomes: Before: resume carries muted=true; late fulfillment pauses media and rewinds 0.828424 -> 0.517615, then currentTime stays fixed.
After: all three scenarios keep muted=false and paused=false, do not rewind replacement music, and the native clock advances; pageErrors is empty.
limitations: This tests controlled promise ordering on actual media, not naturally occurring network frequency or physical audio latency.
Actual iPad Safari and touch/audio synchronization are unverified.
Other shared context/hit-mixer activation failures and static first-play priming are not exhausted by this regression.
All official visual/animation/Tips/resource/game-rule/chapter/replay acceptance and real-user save compatibility remain blocked or unverified in docs/fidelity-acceptance.json.
